questions.content: The number of optical isomers possible for [Cr(C<sub>2</sub>O<sub>4</sub>)<sub>3</sub>]<sup>3<mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.186ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.76ex" height="1.505ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -583 778 665" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mo"><use data-c="2212" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-2212"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container></sup> is ____________.
questions.explanation: The number of optical isomers for [Cr(C2O4)3]3 is two.
